verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-serve export of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, or suppression lists in an open format. The only related items are generic API data access ('pull data'), CLI subscriber management, and an inbound Mailchimp importer. These are developer building blocks or opposite-direction migration, so they earn no credit toward an audience-export capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
